method: Static Python AST inspection; no application imports, database connections, secret values, or production probes. Routes and columns are code declarations, not runtime availability or a complete migration description. Router imports, router-owned prefixes, and explicit main.py mounts were resolved statically, including the Decisions module attribute mount. Environment entries contain example-file variable names only, no values; repeated declarations are retained.
scope_notes: SQLAlchemy declarations are not a database introspection or migration audit.
Only statically declared HTTP decorator routes are inventoried; framework-generated documentation/OpenAPI endpoints and externally deployed routes are not listed.
Mounted paths resolve source declarations, not effective reverse-proxy routing or live route availability.
Environment names come only from the named example files, not all environment reads in application code or live deployment configuration.
Source hashes identify the local inspected files; snapshot commit does not certify that every working-tree file is committed.
